identity.name: Iron Guard
identity.description: Gain its block once at fight start. Block is spent when absorbing damage; it does not regenerate. Thorns, when present, retaliates for every enemy strike.
identity.lore: The outer plate keeps its smith's square hammer marks.

effects.description: Gain fight-opening block; spent block does not regenerate.

conditions: Both unlocked ingredients are packed and form an orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Consume nothing if requirements fail. If the result cannot fit after consumption, it remains unpacked.
recipes.description: Combine two Riveted Guard into one Iron Guard.

visual.brief: A small iron heater shield with a substantial folded rim and a raised vertical reinforcing band. Steel planes give the plate visible thickness.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; no colored rim lighting or isolated glints.
definingFeatures: A small iron heater shield with a substantial folded rim and a raised vertical reinforcing band
Steel planes give the plate visible thickness.
